description: Show something you have made or helped build. Personal, study and team projects all belong here, with or without a public repository.
empty: Add a project and share whichever details are useful. Every field is optional.
name: Project name
projectDescriptionHelp: What does it do, or what did you explore? Use your own words.
projectDescriptionPlaceholder: A small guide that helps people find local learning resources.
roleHelp: Optional. Describe your own participation, whether you worked alone or with others.
rolePlaceholder: Planned the content and built the search interface
technologiesHelp: Optional. Add one tool per field. Removing one deletes that entry from this project.
linksHelp: Optional. Share a demo, repository or another public page. Removing a link deletes it from this project.
linkLabelHelp: For example, Demo or Repository. Leave it blank to show the address.
urlHelp: Use a full https:// or http:// address. Email links belong in Contact.
invalidUrl: Enter a full http:// or https:// address without credentials or spaces. You can also clear both fields or remove this link.
removeHelp: Removing a project deletes its description, role, technologies and links from this draft.
